items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Duke and Cab and Baron Lee and Baron Wilkins, was that it? The Blue Ribbon Band.

ctx.x: Some of those bands that played the Small's Paradise, and the Cotton Club Band, Duke and Cab and Baron Lee and Baron Wilkins, was that it? The Blue Ribbon Band. And all those bands, the Savoy, Teddy Hill, Willie Bryant, Benny Carter. And Ralph was with Chick. And the bands that used to play the Renaissance, the West Indian jazz bands.
Right. Well, maybe we're going in circles because Jeter-Pillars (PHONETIC) was coming up from St. Louis to Chicago.
